subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should agent-scoped callers without an exact active sandbox context categorically reject all sandbox paths, including any previously working implicit sandbox-media delivery flows?
rationale: The patch fixes a real cross-session read boundary, but its unconditional fail-closed behavior may intentionally alter shipped media-delivery compatibility; repository security and media ownership must confirm that contract.

options.title: Approve exact-context fail-closed policy
options.body: Confirm that only callers carrying the exact active sandbox workspace may authorize sandbox media, then land the patch after current-head checks and owner review.
